title: Dual-capacity consensus refinement for 200-way 1-shot transductive fine-grained recognition
purpose: Test one bounded method hypothesis in a legitimate lower-accuracy task without weakening the feature extractor or classifier baseline.

data.rotation_rule: sort image IDs within each class and use each position as support exactly once

features.B: frozen official DINOv2 ViT-B/14 L2-normalized CLS
features.L: frozen official DINOv2 ViT-L/14 L2-normalized CLS
features.BL: L2-normalized concatenation of individually normalized B and L CLS

fixed_inference.known_query_prior: exactly 9 examples per class in this balanced benchmark setting

standard_baselines: B, L, and BL cosine nearest support
B, L, and BL class-balanced Sinkhorn assignment
B, L, and BL single-view soft prototype refinement with identical temperature, marginal constraint, steps, and support-query mix

proposed_method.name: DCCR
proposed_method.description: At each step, obtain balanced B and L assignments, form a balanced geometric-mean consensus, weight each query by B/L distributional agreement, and update B and L prototypes from the labelled support plus agreement-weighted query centres. Final labels come from the balanced consensus.

primary_endpoint: mean query balanced accuracy over ten support rotations

go_no_go.gain_gate: DCCR exceeds the strongest standard baseline mean by at least 1.0 percentage point
go_no_go.rotation_gate: DCCR is non-inferior to the strongest paired standard baseline in at least 8 of 10 rotations
go_no_go.worst_rotation_gate: DCCR minus the strongest paired standard baseline is not below -0.5 percentage points in any rotation
go_no_go.on_go: freeze all inference choices, extract L features for episodes 2 and 3, and run confirmation without retuning
go_no_go.on_no_go: close DCCR; retain PAT-K-260729-001 only as task-regime evidence and do not claim a new method

interpretation_limits: PAT-K-260729-001 inspected five temperatures and is diagnostic rather than confirmatory
balanced Sinkhorn and prototype refinement are prior methods and cannot be claimed as novel
a balanced-query result alone does not establish robustness to unknown or imbalanced query priors
